facts.fact: Treasury CS Mbadi told the Senate on 2 October 2024 that the eCitizen platform handles 120,000 transactions daily and collected Ksh100.8 billion in FY2023/24.
CS Mbadi stated eCitizen performs 120,000 transactions daily and collected Ksh100.8 billion in 2023/24 against Ksh26 billion in 2022/23.
